com.unitech.lib.uhf.params

Class Lock6cParam

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.unitech.lib.uhf.params.Lock6cParam

  • public class Lock6cParam
extends java.lang.Object
    The Lock6cParam class is used to pass information that the RFID UHF's Lock command performs.

      • Lock6cParam

        public Lock6cParam(LockState killPassword,
                   LockState accessPassword,
                   LockState epc,
                   LockState tid,
                   LockState user)
        Creates an instance of the Lock6cParam class.
        Parameters:
        killPassword - LockState enum indicating the Access operation for Kill Password area of the Reserved Memory of the tag.
        accessPassword - The LockState enumeration that indicates the Access operation for Access Memory area of the Reserved Memory of the tag.
        epc - A LockState enum indicating the Access behavior for the tag's EPC memory.
        tid - The LockState enumeration indicating the Access behavior for the tag's TID memory.
        user - The LockState enumeration that indicates the Access behavior for the tag User Memory.
